# HD GitHub source acquisition
Mobile source: 3 character groups with actual PNG plus SpriteFrames scene data. No rig or source code execution. Candidate IDs and costumes not automatically remapped. SFF/AIR from 15 Naruto characters in StormBudokai repository; inspect idle dimensions before accepting HD. Large R36S repository has mostly Git LFS pointers: do not treat pointer as binary. Public workflow retains source data only in runner and publishes numeric evidence, not source art. Existing game is unchanged; Devolution and Senki remain HOLD as main character art. Run the script on a private workspace with Python/Pillow to generate local source and GIF review.
